prompt:
Design brief — your own take on this character. A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Tellurium (텔루륨) itself — the sovereign of the Tellurium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags.

You design her yourself: invent her face, eye colour, hairstyle, makeup, expression, pose and setting as a fresh, original take — do not follow any earlier design of this character. Her hair colour and costume are NOT free: take them from our designs below.

Style (fixed): A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish.

Inspiration only — her element: tellurium: a brittle, lustrous silver-white metalloid found in 1782 in gold ore from the mountains of Transylvania, so puzzling it was called paradoxical gold, and named in 1798 from Latin tellus, the earth, so that its look-alike found later was named selenium, for the moon; one of the very few elements that join with gold, it formed the grey telluride ores of the 1890s gold rushes; a trace of it leaves a garlic smell on the breath; its compounds turn heat straight into electricity. Palette: rich earth brown, silver-white metallic lustre, telluride gold, pale moon silver.

World (fixed): a mountain kingdom of the living earth: terraced fields of rich brown soil climbing every slope, mine galleries where brittle silver-white crystals grow tangled with gold so that miners call them the paradox vein, a round earthen altar on the summit that always faces a great pale silver moon, even by day. Her costume and setting belong to this world.

Costume (choose one of ours, then add your own idea): pick ONE of these costume shapes from our set and keep its overall silhouette — 1) leather armor with a short cloak, a lowered hood, bracers and boots — a light, agile ranger's silhouette; 2) a fitted breastplate and pauldrons above a gown skirt flaring to the floor — an elegant lady-knight silhouette; 3) large metal feathered wing ornaments spreading from the shoulders or back and a wing-shaped head ornament — the wings make the shape; 4) thin leaf-patterned armor plates and flowing light fabric panels with a slender circlet — a slender, graceful silhouette; 5) a fur cloak, leather straps, minimal metal plates and bone and tooth ornaments — a rugged, wild warrior silhouette; 6) a long coat below the knees with epaulettes, a belt, gloves and tall boots — a crisp, commanding officer's silhouette; 7) a floor-length priestly vestment with gold-trimmed stoles and a tall head ornament — a long, devout silhouette; 8) a great crown and a fur-trimmed royal mantle over an ornate breastplate — a ceremonial, regal silhouette. Then add one signature idea of your own drawn from her element, built into the construction of the outfit itself rather than as a print or a loose accessory — e.g. plates or cloth layered like crystals, scales or flames, a hem or sleeve cut into a shape from her element. Build it in this world's materials and our colours below.

Costume colours (ours): rich earth brown, silver-white metallic lustre, telluride gold, pale moon silver.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): warm earth-brown hair with a silvery metallic sheen and fine gold glints. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described above.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

If you have already drawn a free design of her in this session, make this one clearly different — another face and hairstyle (the same hair colour), another costume shape with another signature idea, another pose and setting.

Write your own detailed image prompt from this brief, then draw it. One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Te) and atomic number (52) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.

Detailed design chosen for this image:
Choose the fur-cloaked rugged wild warrior silhouette. Signature construction: earth-brown leather panels joined along irregular silver-white crystal seams with embedded gold, a short asymmetrical layered hide skirt and strong boots, bare shoulders and deep neckline with covered intimate areas. Adult woman with warm olive skin, grey-violet eyes, soft heart-shaped face, earth-brown hair with silver metallic sheen and fine gold glints in a short wavy bob. Relaxed powerful stance, both empty hands visible, entrance of a mountain gold-crystal gallery beneath terraces.
